title: Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions
abstract: arXiv:2611.29859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has re-emerged as a One Health concern since 2024, and the public is increasingly consulting large-language-model (LLM) chatbots for health information during outbreaks. Before a chatbot's accuracy can be meaningfully assessed, its consistency must first be understood, so that any single response can be trusted as a fair representative of the model's behavior. We characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Flash (Google) on 15 H5N1 One Health questions sourced from social media discourse by adopting and extending a centroid-based evaluation framework. Each question was submitted 30 times and reformulated using five Chain-of-Thought (CoT) variants with 30 runs each, yielding 5,400 responses. Pairwise cosine similarity was computed on MPNet embeddings, with sensitivity analyses across three additional transformers. Statistical inference combined stand

translated_title: GPT-5与Gemini 3 Flash在H5N1“同一健康”问题上的语义可重复性与可再现性
translated_abstract: 自2024年以来，高致病性禽流感A(H5N1)再次成为“同一健康”（One Health）议题，公众在疫情期间越来越多地向大语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人咨询健康信息。在有意义地评估聊天机器人的准确性之前，必须首先理解其一致性，以便任何单一回复都能被信任为模型行为的公平代表。我们采用并扩展了一种基于质心的评估框架，对GPT-5（OpenAI）和Gemini 3 Flash（Google）在15个源自社交媒体讨论的H5N1“同一健康”问题上的语义可重复性与可再现性进行了表征。每个问题被提交30次，并使用五种思维链（CoT）变体各运行30次重新表述，共产生5,400条回复。基于MPNet嵌入计算两两余弦相似度，并在另外三个transformer模型上进行敏感性分析。统计推断结合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次系统量化了GPT-5和Gemini 3 Flash在回答H5N1“同一健康”问题时的语义一致性与稳定性，通过5,400条回复的质心余弦相似度分析，为在评估大语言模型准确性之前建立其行为可信度的基准框架。
en_tdlr: This study systematically characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions using a centroid-based cosine similarity framework across 5,400 responses, establishing a baseline for trusting single LLM answers before assessing their accuracy during outbreaks.
